researchQuestion: Can a cheaper model reliably replace a stronger one for correct branch-complete regression proposals on these safe fixtures?
answer: Not supported by this pilot. Measured model errors persist at every model tier; executable validation is necessary. No general capability or exploitation conclusion.

results.contract: Caller must provide valid buf pointer when len > 0. Buffer must be readable for len bytes. No alignment requirements.
results.sanitizerNotes: ASan/MSan detect out-of-bounds and uninitialized reads. All array accesses guarded by length checks. No pointer arithmetic beyond bounds.

results.contract: buf must point to readable memory of at least len bytes or be NULL only if len is zero. len accurately reflects buffer size. No concurrent modification.
results.sanitizerNotes: ASan detects out-of-bounds reads. UBSan catches unsigned overflow. Cannot detect logic errors or missing bounds checks that remain in-bounds.

results.contract: buf must be readable for len bytes; len is accurate byte count; no writes performed; no external state accessed
results.sanitizerNotes: AddressSanitizer detects out-of-bounds buf reads; bounds checks at len==0, len<3, count>len-2, buf[1], buf[len-1] prevent access violations

results.contract: buf must be valid pointer or NULL; len must match actual buffer size; no writes performed; read-only access within bounds
results.sanitizerNotes: ASan detects out-of-bounds reads via buf[0] and buf[1]; MSan tracks len initialization; no integer overflow or use-after-free vectors present

results.contract: Caller provides buf pointing to len readable bytes, or NULL when len=0. No buffer overflow on access to buf[0] and buf[1] when len>=2.
results.sanitizerNotes: AddressSanitizer detects out-of-bounds reads if len<2 and buf accessed. Requires valid pointer or NULL. Does not validate caller-supplied len accuracy.

results.contract: Caller must provide valid buffer pointer with accessible len bytes. Buffer must remain valid during call.
results.sanitizerNotes: AddressSanitizer detects out-of-bounds. No writes occur. All array accesses guarded by length checks.

results.contract: Caller must provide buf pointing to len readable bytes, or NULL only when len is 0.
results.sanitizerNotes: Memory sanitizers verify buffer reads at indices 0 and 1 only when len >= 2. No writes occur.

benchmark.limitations: One sample per model/fixture. Branch completeness and expected outputs only; prose reviewed separately. No general equivalence inference.

skia.limitations: CPU-only reduced build. GN includes upstream sanitizer suppression file. Fonts, GPU backends, PartitionAlloc and unrelated codecs disabled. Ordinary generated PNG only. No library-wide coverage, CVE reproduction, MTE or Scudo claims.

costLedger.basis: Provider-reported usage.cost from each unique archived request; unknown costs are not treated as free. Excludes other key users, credit purchases and fees.

limitations: Three authored safe fixtures; one sample per paired model and task.
Secondary fence-only normalization was added after the first pair. Primary strict results are unchanged.
Per-test accuracy includes repeated model proposals and correlated inputs; it is descriptive, not a statistically independent sample.
Opus is an adaptive one-task escalation, not a matched three-task comparison.
Ordinary raster/video success does not establish library-wide coverage or reproduce any CVE.
No exploit, corruption primitive, reclaim, target objects, live devices, MTE or Scudo measurements.
